{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Basic_foodstuffs|Basic Foodstuffs]] | [[Cookbook:Vegan_Substitutions|Vegan Substitutions]]

This '''vegan fish sauce''' imitation is intended to mimic the umami flavor of the original, which is derived from anchovies.

==Ingredients==
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] shredded dried [[Cookbook:Seaweed|seaweed]]
* 4 cups [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 3 very large cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], crushed but not peeled
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] black [[Cookbook:Peppercorn|peppercorns]]
* ½ cup dark Chinese [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* Extra boiling water as needed

==Procedure==
# Place the seaweed in a pot and add 4 cups of water. 
# Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], then turn down the heat to keep it bubbling along. 
# Cook for 20 minutes.
# Add the rest of the ingredients and enough water to make about 6 cups total in the pot. 
# Bring back to a boil, then boil fairly high for at least ½ hour. 
# At that point, begin to taste (just a little, though—it's strong). 
# When the stock is reduced by about half, it will be almost too salty to eat, and that means it is ready. 
# [[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] through fine mesh or a coffee filter and allow to cool.
